thread:
ana_release: Quick sync — planning a coordinated cut tonight at 00:00 PDT (quiet window). Wave includes runtime quantize=q8 toggle (v1.9.0), router cookie-affinity change (cookie-aff=on), console small API contract tweak expecting session_id, and API pinned to v2.4.0 for canary. Goal: reduce token cost and improve routing for sticky sessions. Any objections?

 tom_runtime: runtime build looks good for v1.9.0 with q8. Note: quantize path can increase CPU on the host side briefly during cold kernels; suggest a 5m soak on canary nodes. Will enable RUNTIME_QUANTIZE=1 on canary only.

 lee_console: console change only reads session_id when present, but our UI assumes streaming sessions are routed sticky. If router changes cookie semantics we might see session_id nulls -> UI stream reconnects. I'll add a defensive fallback to continue rendering without session_id.

 garrett_router: cookie-aff toggle will change SameSite and Set-Cookie semantics for the router -> we planned it to improve stickiness across internal gateways. I can gate with flag router-cookie-aff-7123 on canary routers. We'll only flip on canary.

 mai_qe: I'll run streaming soak + session stickiness matrix in staging with API pinned to v2.4.0. Plan synthetic long-lived streams (5m) + churn. ETA 15m.

 ana_release: Canary plan: 15% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> full. Rollback triggers: streaming disconnects > baseline*2, session-affinity failures > 1% sustained for 5m, or p95 latency > baseline+40ms. Also immediate rollback if console errors increase (UI crashes).

 deploybot: @channel Deploybot will kick off canary in ~12m. Snapshot: runtime:v1.9.0-quantize, router:flag=router-cookie-aff-7123(canary), console:v1.6.2-session-fallback, api:v2.4.0-pinned. Preflight: unit tests, streaming-smoke, sticky-session matrix. Logs -> #release-logs. :rocket:

 tom_runtime: adding runtime.metric.quantize_cpu and runtime.quantize.cold_kernels to canary dashboard. Will pre-warm kernels for 3m before traffic.

 garrett_router: enabling router-cookie-aff-7123 on router-canary-1 and router-canary-2 only. Not touching main routers.

 mai_qe: started soak. First 3 mins look ok. Running long streams now.

 mai_qe: observed spike in stream reconnects on canary: +180% vs baseline. Error seen on client side: "ERR_STREAM_NO_ROUTE". Router logs show dropped cookie on follow-up requests: ```WARN router.cookie - missing session cookie for request /v1/stream id=abcd-1234```

 lee_console: getting NPE in UI stream handler when session_id is null, occasionally causing the client to hard-refresh. Snippet: ```TypeError: cannot read property 'length' of null at StreamHandler.render (stream.js:112)```

 ana_release: Hold hold. Do not advance to 50%. Rollback router flag on canary and pause runtime quantize toggle. We need to stabilize streams first.

 deploybot: Pausing progression. Rolling back router flag on canary clusters and toggling RUNTIME_QUANTIZE=0 on canary nodes. Will update when done.

 garrett_router: rolled back router-cookie-aff-7123 on canary clusters. Confirming cookie behavior restored to previous.

 tom_runtime: reverted quantize flag on canary pool. Runtime metrics returning to baseline.

 mai_qe: re-running streaming matrix. Reconnects dropped back to baseline after rollback. No more ERR_STREAM_NO_ROUTE.

 lee_console: pushed a defensive client patch to handle missing session_id gracefully (v1.6.2-1), but we'll hold until canary routing is proven stable.

 ana_release: Decisions/TODOs: 1) revert router cookie-aff effort from this wave and open a follow-up RFC to validate cookie semantics across gateways, 2) require explicit session-affinity canary plan in runbook, 3) add streaming end-to-end soak in preflight for any router or runtime affinity changes, 4) add API pin enforcement in console deploy specs, 5) schedule a kernel-prewarm step for runtime quantize. I'll file follow-up tickets and tag owners.

 deploybot: Router rollback complete; runtime toggle reverted; traffic frozen at 15% canary for API only. Notifying @release-team. :white_check_mark:
